name: Manhattan Community Garden Sites Data
description:
This dataset lists 151 community garden sites across Manhattan, including school gardens, community gardens, NYCHA sites, and senior center gardens. Each record provides the site's name, type, street address, contact information, postcode, and geographic coordinates, along with administrative geography fields such as community board, council district, census tract, building identification number (BIN), borough-block-lot (BBL), and neighborhood tabulation area (NTA). A small share of records (about 7%) lack location and administrative fields.

The data can be used to map and analyze how gardens are distributed across Manhattan, compare garden types by neighborhood, and connect sites to political and census districts for urban agriculture and land-use planning. It also serves as a practical directory for residents, researchers, and city agencies looking to find or contact local gardens.
